name: debounce
title: Implement debounce with leading option
prompt:
Implement `debounce(fn, wait, options)` in `debounce.js` (CommonJS export):
- returns a function; calls are delayed until `wait` ms have passed without a new call, then `fn`
  runs ONCE with the latest arguments and the latest `this`
- `options.leading === true`: the first call of a burst runs `fn` immediately; further calls during
  the burst are delayed, and `fn` runs once more at the end only if there were further calls
- the returned function has a `cancel()` method that drops any pending call
